title: EXAMPLE: Essay with every building block
dek: Dek: the one or two sentences under the title. Fill it in the Dek property at the top of this row.
meta: Meta note: extra words after the date
html:
👀
Working example of the Essay template with every building block. See it on your site at adjoakittoe.com/#example-essay↗ (Preview is checked, so it is not listed anywhere). Each gray line explains the block right under it. To start a real essay: open the ••• menu at the top right of this page → Duplicate, rename it, change the Slug, delete the gray lines and this box, then write.

Text before the first heading is the opening of the essay. It has no section name.

Text styles

Heading 1: type /h1 and press Enter. Every Heading 1 starts a new section, and its name appears in the section menu pill at the bottom of the page.

A Heading 2 is a subsection

Type /h2. For a smaller heading type /h3.

A Heading 3 is a small heading

This paragraph has bold, italic, crossed out, a chartreuse highlight, muted gray words, and inline code.

How: select the words, then use the toolbar that pops up. B = bold, i = italic, S = crossed out. Highlight: click A (color) → under Background pick Yellow. Muted: click A → under Text pick Gray. Inline code: click the <> button.

Links

Link to any website: select the words → click Link in the toolbar → paste the address. On the site it gets a dotted underline and a small ↗.

Read more from the Whole Grains Council↗.

Link to another page on your site: type @ then start typing the page title, and pick it. The page must be a row in Essays & Vibe Projects.

See the EXAMPLE: Recipe for the recipe layout.

Citations

Type a number in square brackets right after a sentence, like 1. On the site it becomes a small raised number that shows the source when hovered. The source itself goes in the numbered list under the Sources heading at the very end of the page.

Fonio has been grown in West Africa for thousands of years.1

Lists

Plain bullets: type - and a space.

  • First thing
  • Second thing

Numbered steps with round number badges: type 1. and a space, and start every item with bold words.

  1. Rinse the grain. The bold words become the step title.
  2. Toast it. Every item in the list needs bold words at the start, or it shows as a plain list.

Glossary (term on the left, meaning on the right): bullets where every item starts with a bold word followed by a colon.

Fonio
a tiny, fast-cooking grain.
Teff
the grain used to make injera.

Checklist: type [] and a space.

  • A done item
  • An open item

Quotes

Type " and a space for a quote block. To add who said it: inside the quote press Shift+Enter for a new line, then type ~ and the name. That line becomes the attribution.

Write the quote here.

Name of the person

Note boxes

Type /callout. The icon you pick shows on the site. Click the icon to change it.

🌱
A note box. Use it for asides.

Row of big numbers: a callout with the 📊 icon. One number per line (Shift+Enter between lines). Make the number bold, then the label after it.

33% example label one
1,200 example label two
8 example label three

Tables

Type /table. Click the table → ••• (Options) → turn on Header row. The first row becomes the table header.

GrainCook timeOrigin
Fonio5 minWest Africa
Teff20 minEthiopia

Facts table: same, but leave Header row off and use two columns. Label on the left, value on the right.

Grown inWest Africa
Cook timeAbout 5 minutes

Clickable timeline: type /toggle and name it exactly Timeline. Inside it, add a table with Header row on and three columns: Year, Title, Detail.

2015. What happened. This shows when someone clicks the year.

2020. Another detail.

Images

Type /image → Upload → pick the photo. Click below the photo to write a caption. The sample photos on this page are placeholders. Swap in yours.

Edge to edge: end the caption with (wide).

Side by side: drag one image next to another until a blue vertical line appears, and Notion makes columns.

Slideshow with arrows: /toggle named exactly Slideshow, with images inside it.

Photo grid: /toggle named exactly Gallery, with images inside it.

Photo on hover

Select the word → click A (color) → under Text pick Purple. Then open the Hover Images database and add a row whose Name is the same word, add the photo in Image, and check Publish. There is already an example row named fonio: add any photo to it and check Publish to see this one work.

This is a sentence about fonio with a photo on hover.

Video and link cards

Video: type /video → Embed link → paste a YouTube or Vimeo address. On the site it becomes a card that plays in the middle of the screen.

Link card: paste any web address on an empty line and choose Create bookmark from the menu that pops up.

Download button: type /file → Upload → pick a PDF. The caption becomes the button text.

Other blocks

Question that opens and closes: /toggle with any name other than Slideshow, Gallery, or Timeline.

A question people ask?

The answer shows when someone clicks.

Divider line: type --- (three dashes).

Code box: type /code.

Anything typed here keeps its spacing.

Sources

Heading 1 named exactly Sources, then a numbered list. Item 1 matches 1 in the text, item 2 matches 2, and so on.

  1. Example source: author, title, and a link↗.

title: EXAMPLE: Recipe
dek: The one or two sentences under the title go in the Dek property at the top of this row.
html:
👀
Working example of the Recipe template. See it on your site at adjoakittoe.com/#example-recipe↗ (Preview is checked, so it is not listed anywhere). Gray lines explain the block under them. To start a real recipe: open the ••• menu at the top right of this page → Duplicate, rename it, change the Slug, delete the gray lines and this box.

Ingredients

Serves 4

Heading 1 named exactly Ingredients. Then a bulleted list. Start each line with the amount (1, ½, 1 1/2, 2.5) and a unit (cup, tbsp, tsp, g, oz, can, clove, pinch...). Those amounts change when someone presses − or + next to Serves. Serves comes from the Serves property (4 here).

  • 1 cup fonio
  • 2 cups water
  • ½ tsp salt
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 small onion, diced
  • 2 cloves garlic

Method

Heading 1 named exactly Method. Then a numbered list. Start each step with bold words: they become the step title. To add a margin tip beside a step: click at the end of the step, press Enter, press Tab (indents it under the step), type /callout and write the tip.

  1. Rinse the fonio. Put it in a fine strainer and rinse until the water runs clear.
    This is a margin tip. It shows beside step 1 on the site.
  2. Toast it. Warm the oil in a pot, add the onion and garlic, then stir in the fonio for two minutes.
  3. Steam it. Add the water and salt, cover, and cook on low for five minutes. Fluff with a fork.

To serve

Any other Heading 1 (To serve, Notes) is a normal section. It shows in the section menu.

Serve warm with greens.

Notes

Keeps three days in the fridge.

Sources

Heading 1 named exactly Sources, then a numbered list. Typing 1 anywhere in the page links to item 1 here.

  1. Example source: the name of the book or site, and the link.
